script_text: Aries, something shifted under your feet before sunrise — and you are not imagining it. Mars, your ruling planet, is firing a bold trine to the Sun in Sagittarius, your 9th House, while Jupiter rides alongside in your 5th House of romance and risk. But Venus sits at one degree Capricorn in your 10th House, squaring that Sun, so love and ambition tug at opposite ends of your fire element. Saturn is retrograde in your 1st House, so this pressure has been building. Single? Someone with authority — a boss, a mentor — steps into your world tonight, and it's instant. Taken? Watch your tone — money and pride collide tonight. Career-wise, that square delays a contract or raise — never sign under pressure. Skip impulse buys; instead, an unexpected green light arrives for a project you shelved. Follow for tomorrow's reading, and comment your sign.
